title: Pre-registered closed-loop confirmation: does head-only COISC adaptation remove the closed-loop cost of R0 reversed first moves without degrading other operating points?
author_approval: Author approved option B on 2026-11-05 (panel A: R0-wrong pairs on all 24 plants; panel B: 40 seeds x 12 scenarios x 6 fixed plants).
what_is_already_known_before_any_run: The 40 seeds 20261101-20261140, their R0/COISC/L0 checkpoints and holdout metrics (SCREENING_PROTOCOL sha 46fc592f...).

Plant-free first decisions of every model on the 12 locked scenarios; the 6 R0-wrong pairs are (20261109,S12), (20261118,S10), (20261124,S10), (20261132,S04), (20261135,S04), (20261137,S12). COISC first move is correct on 4, zero on 1, wrong on 1 of them.
Closed-loop MIL of R0/COISC/L0 on 13 earlier seeds (onset-aligned study), where any COISC benefit was concentrated on seeds with R0-wrong first moves.
No closed-loop run of any of the 40 new seeds exists; the outcomes below are unseen.

models.source: <outputs>/screening/study/seed_*/ (R0 = results/R0/selected.pt, COISC_final.pt, L0_final.pt); all checkpoint SHA-256 bound at freeze
models.COISC_onset_excluded_reason: secondary variant of the screening study; not part of this paper's main comparison

bench.runner: timc_coisc/onset_mil.run_one, unchanged (60 control updates, 37 C reference, frozen MPCConfig, no T_p feedback to the controller)
bench.plants: 24 primary learned plants in 4 families (CONTROL_PLANT_FAMILY_LOCK), family-equal weighting
bench.panel_A: R0-wrong pairs x all 24 plants x 3 variants
bench.panel_B: 40 seeds x 12 scenarios x plants (0,5,11,8,20,23) x 3 variants; plants fixed by model id before any run: F1 = P, A1, A3 (first seed of each); F2 = A2; F3 = B2; F4 = B1
bench.metric: MAE_track (deg C) of plant T_p against 37 C over the 60 updates (analyze_formal_control_v3.trace_metrics, unchanged)

hypotheses.H1_primary: On the R0-wrong pairs, COISC improves closed-loop tracking over R0: unit = pair, effect = family-equal mean over 24 plants of MAE[COISC] - MAE[R0]; supported iff every pair is evaluable and the 95% percentile bootstrap CI upper bound (20,000 draws over pairs, seed 20261105) is < 0.
hypotheses.H2_primary: On all other seed-scenario pairs, COISC is non-inferior to R0: unit = seed, effect = mean over that seed's non-R0-wrong scenarios of the family-equal mean over the 6 panel-B plants of MAE[COISC] - MAE[R0]; supported iff all 40 seeds are evaluable and the 95% bootstrap CI upper bound (over seeds) is < 0.10 C.
hypotheses.verdict: SUPPORTED iff H1 and H2 are both supported; otherwise PARTIAL_H1_ONLY, PARTIAL_H2_ONLY or NOT_SUPPORTED. The verdict is reported whatever it is.
hypotheses.margin_justification: 0.10 C is about 5% of the mean closed-loop MAE_track of R0 on this bench (1.95 C over the 13 earlier seeds); it is fixed a priori as a small fraction of the bench MAE, before any closed-loop run of these 40 seeds. No physical tolerance is claimed for it.

secondary_descriptive: Panel A: L0 - R0 and COISC - L0 (matched fine-tuning control), point, CI, per-pair values; number of pairs improved
Panel B: the same three contrasts over unaffected pairs and over all pairs
Panel B: mean MAE_track, total variation of u, saturation fraction and solver success rate per variant
missing_data_rule: A run is non-evaluable only by trace_metrics (non-finite or out-of-range trace). A (seed, scenario, plant) cell is used only if all three variants are evaluable; dropped cells are counted and reported. No run, plant, scenario or seed is deleted for any other reason.

gates_before_freeze.G1: cl_mil.py gate: 12 stored E2 runs of seed 20261001 (R0 and L0) re-executed bitwise (applied_UH and plant_Tp)
gates_before_freeze.G2: cl_analyze.py gate: metric extraction reproduces all 576 stored E2 R0/L0 MAE_track values of seed 20261001 exactly; synthetic selftest recovers planted effects and verdict logic
gates_before_freeze.smoke: cl_mil.py smoke and cl_analyze.py smoke on screening smoke checkpoints (seed 1), outside the study directory

execution: cl_mil.py execute 6, then cl_analyze.py analyze; same-hash resume skips finished runs; the Windows power-throttling (EcoQoS) flag of the worker processes may be cleared without affecting results
deviations_policy: Any change after freeze is logged as an amendment with reason and disclosed in the manuscript.
